description: NVIDIA Transformer-based end-to-end speaker diarization model trained primarily on English speech, predicting speaker labels directly from audio and resolving speaker ordering by arrival time for up to four speakers. The streaming checkpoints (v2) run chunked with an arrival-order speaker cache, so recordings of any length diarize in bounded memory; the offline v1 checkpoints run one whole-window graph.

request.name: speaker_threshold
request.description: Speaker activity probability threshold used when decoding speaker turns; default 0.5.

request.name: speaker_min_frames
request.description: Minimum decoded segment length in model output frames; default 0 disables short-segment filtering.

request.name: speaker_pad_frames
request.description: Pad each decoded speaker segment by this many model output frames before filtering and merging; default 0.

request.name: stream_preset
request.description: How the recording is diarized. default: chunked with the checkpoint's shipped streaming operating point (AOSC speaker cache + FIFO) when the package ships one, otherwise one whole-window graph. offline: always whole-window (bounded by session_len_sec). very_high_latency (~30.4 s lookahead, the published offline operating point), high_latency (~10 s), low_latency (~1.04 s): the publisher's validated chunk geometries; small: a diagnostic geometry that forces several chunks and a cache compression on short clips.

request.name: stream_chunk_len
request.description: Chunked diarization: frames of new audio per chunk (80 ms frames). Overrides the preset / shipped geometry and forces the chunked path.

request.name: stream_left_context
request.description: Chunked diarization: frames of left context prepended to each chunk; default 1.

request.name: stream_right_context
request.description: Chunked diarization: frames of lookahead appended to each chunk (the latency lever of the presets).

request.name: stream_fifo_len
request.description: Chunked diarization: frames held in the FIFO before they move into the speaker cache; 0 moves every chunk straight through.

request.name: stream_spkcache_len
request.description: Chunked diarization: speaker-cache capacity in frames (compressed back to this size whenever it overflows).

request.name: stream_update_period
request.description: Chunked diarization: frames popped from the FIFO into the speaker cache per update.

session.name: graph_arena_mb
session.description: Inference graph arena size in MiB; default 512.

session.name: weight_context_mb
session.description: Weight context size in MiB; default 128.

session.name: session_len_sec
session.description: Whole-window graph context length in seconds; must be positive, default 20. Longer input is rejected on the whole-window path (never trimmed); the chunked path (stream_preset) has no length limit.

session.name: graph_capacity_mode
session.description: Offline graph capacity policy; defaults to tiered on host-graph backends and fixed otherwise.

session.name: speaker_threshold
session.description: Default speaker activity probability threshold for decoded speaker turns; default 0.5.

session.name: speaker_min_frames
session.description: Default minimum decoded segment length in model output frames; default 0 disables short-segment filtering.

session.name: speaker_pad_frames
session.description: Default decoded segment padding in model output frames; default 0.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: All weight storage type; default f32.

session.name: matmul_weight_type
session.description: Matmul weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise f32.

session.name: conv_weight_type
session.description: Convolution weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise f32.
